items.title: [ID DRAFT] The November 2026 pacs.008 Structured-Address Deadline: A Six-Month View
items.summary: From November 2026, SWIFT CBPR+ requires structured postal addresses in cross-border payment messages. With six months to go, 65% of payment messages still contain unstructured addresses and 44% of banks remain behind schedule.
